title: 1st Sitting of Third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/1/3/2026).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 25/2/2026 to 27/2/2026).
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation (Tax Administration Act, Law No. 3/2010, Article 8) is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request for Parliament's approval for the Maldives to join the OIC "Makkah Al-Mukarramah Convention" on anti-corruption law enforcement cooperation is sent to the relevant standing committee.
Preliminary debate on the Asset Recovery Bill (on property obtained through crime), submitted on behalf of the government by Fuvahmulah Central MP Ali Fazad.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The first sitting of the new session approved old minutes, sent a tax-office appointment and an OIC anti-corruption convention to committees, and began debating the Asset Recovery Bill.
